honors.title: Robertson Scholar
honors.description: The Robertson Scholarship is a full merit scholarship program at Duke University and the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. The program requires a semester in residence at the “sister campus” and provides full access to programs and courses at both institutions.
honors.issuer: Issued by Robertson Scholars Leadership Program · Jan 2021

honors.title: Renwick Scholar
honors.description: The Renwick Academic Award recognizes all Black/African American, American Indian/Native American, Hispanic/Latinx students who have achieved a cumulative grade point average of 3.2 or higher, to reflect the university average.
honors.issuer: Issued by Center for Student Success in the College of Arts & Sciences
